# AisleMeal (货架健餐)

> Open-source, local-first healthy meal planner and grocery list for Chinese home cooking.

AisleMeal helps people who struggle to cook healthy meals: enter body stats for daily calorie/protein/fat/carb targets, tick pantry ingredients (or a common-kitchen preset), pick dishes for the week, auto-plan remaining slots, then generate a named shopping list only after kcal and protein land in 90–110% of the cooked-meal target. Recipes are at most 5 steps and filtered by home equipment (rice cooker, air fryer, microwave, stove).

It is not a supermarket, not grocery delivery, not a cloud diet tracker, and not medical advice. No login, no backend, no prices. User data stays in browser localStorage (`aislemeal:v1`).

- Site / repo: https://github.com/bigu1/AisleMeal
- Chinese README: https://github.com/bigu1/AisleMeal/blob/main/README.md
- English README: https://github.com/bigu1/AisleMeal/blob/main/README.en.md
- Spec: https://github.com/bigu1/AisleMeal/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md
- License: MIT
- Stack: Next.js 16 static export, TypeScript, Tailwind, zustand persist (localStorage `aislemeal:v1` v8), vitest
- Architecture: `src/app` pages → zustand store → pure `src/domain` (Mifflin-St Jeor, planner, 90–110% kcal/protein gate on remaining target, shopping pack ceil). No API routes.
- Data: `data/ingredients.json` + `data/recipes.yaml` compiled by `scripts/build-data.mjs` into `src/generated/`
- Version: 0.6.0 (~210 recipes, 205 generic ingredients)

Optional: `npm install && npm run dev` → http://localhost:3000 (Node.js 20+). Architecture: README.md §架构 / README.en.md §Architecture.
